ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (UNC3944) help-desk MFA reset followed by SSO sign-in from new device/geo
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Scattered Spider / 0ktapus playbook (MGM, Caesars, Clorox intrusions): a help-desk-driven MFA method registration or password reset against an Entra ID / Okta user, followed within ~60 minutes by an interactive sign-in from an IP, country, or unmanaged device the user has never used during the 30-day baseline.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as change_time values(All_Changes.user) as change_actor values(All_Changes.command) as change_action from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where All_Changes.object_category="User" (All_Changes.command IN ("*authentication method*","*security info*","*password*","*MFA*")) by All_Changes.object | rename All_Changes.object as user | eval user=lower(user) | join type=inner user [ | tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as signin_time values(Authentication.src) as signin_ip values(Authentication.app) as app values(Authentication.user_agent) as ua from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.tag="cloud" by Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as user | eval user=lower(user) ] | where signin_time>=change_time AND signin_time<=change_time+3600 | join type=left user [ | tstats `summariesonly` values(Authentication.src) as known_ips dc(Authentication.src) as ip_baseline from datamodel=Authentication.Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.tag="cloud" earliest=-30d@d latest=-1h by Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as user | eval user=lower(user) ] | eval new_ip=if(isnull(mvfind(known_ips,signin_ip)),1,0) | where new_ip=1 | eval ChangeTime=strftime(change_time,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), SigninTime=strftime(signin_time,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | table ChangeTime, SigninTime, user, change_actor, change_action, signin_ip, app, ua | sort - ChangeTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let BaselineDays = 30d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let MFAActions = dynamic([
    "Reset user authentication method","Reset password (by admin)",
    "Admin registered security info","Update user authentication method",
    "User started security info registration","Delete user authentication method",
    "User registered security info"]);
let MFAChanges = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Application in ("Microsoft Entra ID","Office 365")
    | where ActionType in (MFAActions)
    | mv-expand TargetObj = parse_json(ActivityObjects)
    | where tostring(TargetObj.Type) =~ "Account"
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetObj.Name))
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ChangeTime = Timestamp, ChangeActor = AccountDisplayName,
              ChangeActorIp = IPAddress, ChangeAction = ActionType, TargetUpn;
let UserGeoBaseline = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(WindowMin))
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | extend Upn = tolower(AccountUpn)
    | summarize KnownCountries = make_set(Country, 50),
                KnownIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 250),
                KnownDevices = make_set(AadDeviceId, 50)
              by Upn;
MFAChanges
| join kind=inner (
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | extend Upn = tolower(AccountUpn)
    | project SigninTime = Timestamp, Upn, AccountObjectId,
              SigninIP = IPAddress, Country, UserAgent, AadDeviceId, DeviceTrustType
  ) on $left.TargetUpn == $right.Upn
| where SigninTime between (ChangeTime .. ChangeTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=leftouter (UserGeoBaseline) on Upn
| where (Country !in (KnownCountries)) or (SigninIP !in (KnownIPs)) or (AadDeviceId !in (KnownDevices)) or DeviceTrustType in ("","Unmanaged")
| project ChangeTime, ChangeAction, ChangeActor, ChangeActorIp,
          SigninTime, TargetUpn, SigninIP, Country, UserAgent,
          DeviceTrustType, AadDeviceId
| order by ChangeTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let BaselineDays = 30d;
let WindowMin = 60m;
let MFAOps = dynamic([
    "Reset user authentication method","Reset password (by admin)",
    "Admin registered security info","Update user authentication method",
    "User started security info registration","Delete user authentication method",
    "User registered security info"]);
let MFAChanges = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where OperationName in (MFAOps)
    | where Result =~ "success"
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend ChangeActor = tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy.user)).userPrincipalName)
    | extend ChangeActorIp = tostring(parse_json(tostring(InitiatedBy.user)).ipAddress)
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ChangeTime = TimeGenerated, ChangeActor, ChangeActorIp,
              ChangeAction = OperationName, TargetUpn;
let UserBaseline = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(WindowMin))
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | summarize KnownCountries = make_set(Country, 50),
                KnownIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 250)
              by Upn;
MFAChanges
| join kind=inner (
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true
    | extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, Upn, SigninIP = IPAddress,
              Country, UserAgent, AppDisplayName, DeviceDetail
  ) on $left.TargetUpn == $right.Upn
| where SigninTime between (ChangeTime .. ChangeTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=leftouter (UserBaseline) on Upn
| where (Country !in (KnownCountries)) or (SigninIP !in (KnownIPs))
| project ChangeTime, ChangeAction, ChangeActor, ChangeActorIp,
          SigninTime, TargetUpn, SigninIP, Country, UserAgent, AppDisplayName, DeviceDetail
| order by ChangeTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Reset user authentication method" OR "Admin registered security info" OR "Update user authentication method" OR "Reset password (by admin)" OR "User registered security info") @evt.outcome:success) OR (source:okta @evt.name:(user.mfa.factor.reset_all OR user.mfa.factor.deactivate OR user.account.reset_password OR system.mfa.factor.activate) @outcome.result:SUCCESS)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog Outcome=SUCCESS
| AuthenticationType=/interactive/i
| groupBy([UserPrincipal, ClientIpAddress, UserAgent], function=[min(_time, as=first_seen), count(as=signins)])
| join({ #event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog OperationName=/(reset|register|delete).*(mfa|authentication.method|security.info|password)/i | groupBy([TargetUser, OperationName, ClientIpAddress], function=[min(_time, as=change_time)]) }, field=[UserPrincipal=TargetUser], include=[change_time, OperationName])
| test(first_seen >= change_time and first_seen <= change_time + 3600)

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider commercial RMM stacking — 2+ distinct remote-access tools on one host within 24h
ucs.description: Hunts the Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest hallmark of deploying multiple commercial remote management tools (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Splashtop, Fleetdeck, RustDesk, TeamViewer, Tactical.RMM, Tunnel/Twingate, etc.) on a single endpoint in a short window to ensure resilient C2 and tunnel egress through whitelisted vendor cloud.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.user) as users dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_rmm values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_tools from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","AnyDesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","TeamViewer.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","splashtop.exe","SRService.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","FleetDeckAgent.exe","rustdesk.exe","RustDesk.exe","ngrok.exe","AteraAgent.exe","Syncro.exe","SyncroLive.Service.Runner.exe","LogMeIn.exe","pulseway.exe","PCMonitorSrv.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","BeAnywhere.exe","dwagent.exe","DWAgent.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","twingate.exe","zerotier-one_x64.exe","teleport.exe","ZohoMeeting.exe","AssistantService.exe","plink.exe","ManageEngine.exe","Domotz.exe","Itarian.exe","NCentral.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user span=24h _time | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_rmm >= 2 | eval FirstSeen=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), LastSeen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ") | table FirstSeen, LastSeen, dest, user, distinct_rmm, rmm_tools, cmdlines | sort - LastSeen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let RMMTools = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe",
    "ateraagent.exe","syncro.exe","syncrolive.service.runner.exe","logmein.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","pcmonitorsrv.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","beanywhere.exe","dwagent.exe",
    "simplehelpcustomer.exe","twingate.exe","zerotier-one_x64.exe","teleport.exe",
    "zohomeeting.exe","assistantservice.exe","plink.exe","manageengine.exe",
    "domotz-agent.exe","itarian.exe","ncentral.exe","kabuto.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend BaseName = tolower(FileName)
| where BaseName in (RMMTools)
| summarize
    DistinctRMMs = dcount(BaseName),
    RMMList = make_set(BaseName, 30),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    SampleCmd = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
    Accounts = make_set(AccountName, 10),
    Installers = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10)
    by DeviceName
| where DistinctRMMs >= 2   // Scattered Spider observed stacking 3-5 RMMs per host (CISA AA23-320A)
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let RMMTools = dynamic([
    "anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","fleetdeckagent.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe",

    "simplehelpcustomer.exe","twingate.exe","zerotier-one_x64.exe","teleport.exe",
    "zohomeeting.exe","assistantservice.exe","plink.exe","manageengine.exe",
    "domotz-agent.exe","itarian.exe","ncentral.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountType != "Machine"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend BaseName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BaseName in (RMMTools)
| summarize
    DistinctRMMs = dcount(BaseName),
    RMMList = make_set(BaseName, 30),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    SampleCmd = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
    Accounts = make_set(SubjectUserName, 10),
    Installers = make_set(ParentProcessName, 10)
    by Computer
| where DistinctRMMs >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
